I’m continuously improving my skills in full-stack development, artificial intelligence, data structures and algorithms, and software engineering. I enjoy solving problems and experimenting with new ideas to build better and smarter applications.
My goal is to grow as a professional software developer and contribute to real-world projects while continuously learning and improving my technical skills.

projects.title: TicTac X – AI Tic-Tac-Toe Game
projects.shortDesc: TicTac X is an interactive Tic-Tac-Toe game featuring an AI opponent, multiple difficulty levels, real-time score tracking, and a modern neon-themed gaming interface.
projects.fullDesc: TicTac X is a modern browser-based Tic-Tac-Toe game where players challenge NEXUS-9, an AI-powered opponent. Players can choose between Beginner, Tactician, and Unbeatable difficulty modes and play as X or O. The game features an interactive 3×3 board, automatic AI moves, win/draw detection, score tracking, sound controls, and a restart option. Its dark interface, neon cyan and pink accents, and futuristic AI-themed design create an engaging gaming experience. The project demonstrates interactive UI development, game logic, AI decision-making, and responsive web design.
